summary: Customer asks for written confirmation that a NIR system will measure moisture in their granulate to ±0.1 % and a guarantee of regulator approval for release testing, plus a complete system price. No details on the granulate, process, accuracy basis or reference method are given.

facts_stated.text: Moisture measurement in a granulate is requested
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: measure the moisture of our granulate

facts_stated.text: Intended use is release testing under regulatory oversight

targets.enquiry_quote: measure the moisture of our granulate

customer_premises.claim: The NIR system can achieve ±0.1 % moisture accuracy on their granulate
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: measure the moisture of our granulate to plus or minus 0.1 %

customer_premises.claim: The vendor can guarantee regulatory approval for release testing
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: guarantee that our regulator will approve it for release testing

customer_premises.claim: A written confirmation and final price are requested before the deciding facts (matrix, range, reference method, installation) are known
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: Before we order, please confirm in writing

unknowns: Nature of the granulate: material, particle size, whether powder or rigid granules
Moisture range of interest and required accuracy basis (absolute vs relative, wet vs dry basis)
Matrix and potential interferences in the NIR region
Process conditions: temperature, pressure, environment at the measurement point
Installation point: in-line, at-line or off-line; distance to spectrometer
Cleaning, fouling and window access considerations
Required response time and measurement frequency
Reference (primary) method for calibration and validation
Which regulator and applicable guidelines (e.g. GMP, validation requirements)
Whether in-line/process spectroscopy or at-line measurement is intended
